long_description:
tash is building the investment platform for sports and trading cards. We create professionally constructed portfolios of iconic, investment-grade cards, giving investors exposure to the asset class without the hassle of selecting, buying, storing, and selling individual cards.

Trading card investing remains fragmented, opaque, and difficult to access. tash is building the infrastructure to make the asset class simpler, more transparent, and professionally managed. We are currently pursuing SEC qualification to launch regulated investment offerings backed by trading cards.

launches.tagline: Building the financial infrastructure to bring collectibles into public markets. Starting with trading cards.
launches.body:
**A $50B+ asset class is still being invested in one card at a time. We’re building the investment platform for trading cards.**

**TL;DR:** tash gives investors access to professionally curated portfolios of high-end graded trading cards. tash manages sourcing, verification, vaulting, reporting, and the eventual sale of the underlying assets.

[https://drive.google.com/file/d/1bszOZp6uTWIgG29grz1oxflgInfEvpD6](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1bszOZp6uTWIgG29grz1oxflgInfEvpD6/view)

## The problem

Trading cards have evolved into a global asset class supported by professional grading, extensive sales data, insured vaulting, and multimillion-dollar transactions.

But investing has barely changed.

Today, investors still have to research, source, price, verify, store, track, and eventually resell every card individually. Building diversified exposure often means becoming a part-time card dealer.

Real estate has REITs. Gold has ETFs. Equities have index funds.

The asset class exists. The investment product does not.

## What tash does

tash builds professionally managed trading card portfolios around distinct parts of the market.

Initial portfolios range from broad market exposure through the tash25 Index to focused strategies like GOATs, Rising Stars, Vintage, Pokémon, and TCGs.

Investors gain diversified exposure while tash manages sourcing, verification, secure vaulting, insurance, reporting, and the eventual sale of the underlying cards.

tash is actively pursuing SEC qualification to make these products available to more investors.

## Why us

We grew up collecting cards and never stopped.

Victor, Nathan, and John met in high school before attending UC Berkeley, where they met Nico and became roommates. Together, we have bought and sold more than $1M of trading cards and collectibles.

Our professional experience spans finance, data, and marketplaces, alongside years spent buying at card shows, negotiating, tracking prices, and studying the market.

## The broader vision

Trading cards are the starting point.

tash is building the financial infrastructure needed to bring the broader $330B+ collectibles market into public markets, making cultural assets easier to access, evaluate, and invest in.

Interested in investing in trading cards? Reach out to the team or join the waitlist at [**tash.cards**](http://tash.cards).

Contact: [founders@tash.cards](mailto:founders@tash.cards)
